 Medium
 Large
 Print 6 year old Vedansh with his car (PC: Instagram) This is the real-life example of dreams coming true. Meet Kiran Raikwar and her six-year-old grandson Vedansh. While attending a Garba programme at Abhapuri Dham in Burhanpur, Madhya Pradesh, Kiran bought a lottery coupon under Vendansh’s name. At the time, it was an ordinary decision made during a family festive outing. The family had no idea that the small piece of paper would eventually change their fortune! For the family, owning a Toyota Fortuner was a dream. It was the kind of aspiration that the family hoped to fulfil someday, as two generations wished to bring the premium SUV home. But when the opportunity finally arrived, it came in a way no one could have planned for: through a ₹200 lucky-draw coupon bought by a grandmother at an event. According to a report by Navbharat Times, the lucky draw was held last year, while the Fortuner was handed over to the family in 2026. What began as a modest purchase during a religious and cultural celebration ultimately brought home a vehicle the family had long dreamt of. A random decision that changed family’s life Kiran Raikwar was attending a Garba programme. She randomly bought a lucky-draw coupon for ₹200 and wrote her grandson Vedansh's name on it. She wasn’t expecting anything extraordinary in return. Lucky draws are usually fleeting moments at community events. People buy coupons, participate in the excitement and carry on with their lives. But luck seems to be in their favour. When Vedansh's name emerged as the winner, the family discovered that it had won a Toyota Fortuner reportedly worth around ₹50 lakh. The family went into a pure shock! Two generations and a dream of owning a Fortuner According to Kiran, both her husband and her son had wanted to own the SUV for a long time. For many households, buying a car is more than a financial transaction. A premium SUV can be an especially ambitious purchase for a family that has to weigh it against other financial priorities. In the Raikwars' case, the dream did not come true overnight! It wasn’t a plan purchase but a pleasant surprise or manifestation of years. That is what makes the story extraordinary: the prize was not simply an expensive car but something that two generations had hoped to own. The wait between winning and receiving the car Grandmother Kiran Raikwar with her family (Screenshot) As per reports, the lucky draw took place in 2025, while the car was handed over in 2026 only. The win and the delivery were therefore separate milestones. For the Raikwars, the eventual arrival of the Fortuner marked the fulfilment of a wish that had existed long before the coupon was purchased. A ₹200 entry had led to a prize valued at several lakh times that amount, making the outcome extraordinary by any measure. When an ordinary moment becomes a lifelong memory Their story is a reminder of how unpredictable life can be. Kiran went to a Garba programme, bought a coupon and wrote her grandson's name on it. Nothing about that moment suggested that it would eventually be connected to a luxury SUV. The episode may sound filmy, but it’s as true as it gets. For the Raikwars, the memorable part is not just the value of the prize, but the unexpected way in which their long-held wish came true. Of course, lucky draws depend totally on chance and luck and destiny, and a coupon bought offers no guarantee of winning. But for this family, one ₹200 coupon turned an ordinary festive outing into an extraordinary family story. The generations will tell!
